title: Stop Elementor loading Google Fonts
description: Answers Elementor's own elementor/frontend/print_google_fonts filter with false, so pages stop requesting font files from Google. This uses a switch Elementor documents and supports; Debloater does not reach into another plugin's internals, and where no supported switch exists it reports rather than changes.
breaks: Text falls back to whatever font the visitor's browser has, which is visible on any design that depends on a particular typeface
Elementor's own font settings still say the font is selected, so the editor and the live page will disagree
